name: Citehound
idea: A free scanner that shows whether AI assistants can reach and read a website, with a paid ladder (Pro, Fix, Beyond). The score measures readiness, not whether any assistant recommends, cites or names a brand.
tagline: Scan, fix and write for the way AI answers.

logo.door: functional UI and illustration icon only (crawler states, robots.txt explanations); never a logo, avatar, favicon or listing icon
logo.clearSpace: the height of the hound's ear, about a quarter of the mark's height, on every side
dont: add a door or any second symbol

rules: orange is a field or a button with ink text, not text on light grounds
status colours are for status only

shadow: one soft token on panels: 0 1px 0 rgba(14,27,44,.04), 0 18px 40px -24px rgba(14,27,44,.3)

motion.reducedMotion: everything inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; reduced motion gets the final static state

voice.style: experienced practitioner; short declarative sentences; numbers before adjectives; US English
hardLimits: the score measures readiness; never claim an assistant recommends, cites or names a brand
no promises about traffic, rankings, citations or revenue
no invented numbers, testimonials, logos, ratings or user counts
no official, verified or partner (except official for our own GitHub Action)
third-party names only descriptively; no third-party logos
only live integrations are described as available
llms.txt is optional with no demonstrated effect on Google

images.share: 1200x630 PNG under 300 KB per page type (scripts/generate-og.js)
